value.message: Riverbend Community Centre runs Parent & Tot Playtime, ages 12 months to 4 years, Tuesdays and Thursdays 9:30-11:00, Sept 8 to Dec 11 - their site says. I couldn't pin down the fee or registration details from what I read; their page points to the front desk or a phone call for those. I'll keep watching and text you if that changes.
